description.narrative: The Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH) Agriculture and Rural Development Project aims to assist BiH to strengthen the capacity of its State-level and Entity-level institutions to deliver more efficient and effective agricultural services and support programs as well as to make a substantial contribution to an acceleration of BiH's eligibility to access support under the European Union Instrument for Pre-Accession Assistance for Rural Development (IPARD). It includes the following components: component A -- Agricultural Information and Institutional Capacity Building; component B -- Enhanced Agriculture and Rural Development Support Program; and component C -- Project Coordination, Administration and Monitoring.

The Project Development Objective is to assist BiH to strengthen the capacity of its State-level and Entity-level institutions to deliver more efficient and effective agricultural services and support programs as well as to make a substantial contribution to an acceleration of BiH's eligibility to access support under the European Union Instrument for Pre-Accession Assistance for Rural Development (IPARD).

Finance Agreement :Schedule 2/Section I./B3. | Description :The Recipient shall, and cause the Entities to, adopt a staffing planfor the restructuring of MoFTER, the FBiH MoAWMF, and the RS MoAFWM on terms and conditions satisfactory to the Association. | DueDate :16-Apr-2010

Finance Agreement :Schedule 2/Section I./B4. | Description :The Recipient shall cause the FBiH to establish the FBiH AgricultureExtension Services Agency, in a manner and with the composition and terms of reference satisfactory to the Association | Due Date:16-Apr-2010

Finance Agreement :Schedule 2/Section I./B5. | Description :The Recipient, through MoFTER and the BH PCU, shall duly perform allits obligations under the Operational Manual and the EMF. | Frequency :Quarterly

Finance Agreement :Schedule 2/Section I./B6 | Description :The Recipient shall cause the Entities, through the FBiH MoAWMF/RSMoAFWM and the FBiH PCU/RS PCU to duly perform all their obligations under the OM, FM Manual, RD Grants Manual, and EMF. | Due Date:16-Apr-2010
